name: axHub passes help
description: axHub passes's Help mode entries (help@1), moved from the axHub web app's help when it folded into the console.
author: Brett

entries.title: Go pass
entries.text: Lets a Claude session that can't reach the hub work anyway, for the hours you pick. When it ends, they stop.
entries.tryIt: Pick the hours, add a note, tap Go.

entries.title: Note
entries.text: Optional: what the pass is for. Shown in the pass.

entries.title: Go
entries.text: Starts the pass for the hours you picked. Sessions without the hub may work until it ends.

entries.title: Passes
entries.text: Timed veto passes: what each covers, how long it has left, the calls that ran under it, and ending one early.

entries.title: Ran under a pass
entries.text: Opens the approvals log narrowed to the calls that ran under any pass.

entries.title: min from now
entries.text: Extends the pass so it ends that many minutes from now.

entries.title: Its calls
entries.text: Opens the approvals log narrowed to the calls that ran under this pass.

entries.title: Service
entries.text: The service the pass covers, for example axf-console. Calls from other services still wait for approval.

entries.title: Scope (control@1 target; * matches anything)
entries.text: The control@1 target the pass covers, for example tokens.theme or tokens.*. A star matches anything.

entries.title: Tools (empty = every tool in the scope)
entries.text: The tools the pass covers, comma separated. Leave it empty to cover every tool in the scope.
